M4 — 2026-10-05
An agent that opens a terminal window to start another agent (e.g. `open -na Ghostty.app --args -e zsh -lc 'claude …'`) passes its own CLAUDECODE/CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION/CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID env to that window and to every later tab of the same Ghostty instance; a claude started there runs as a child and saves no transcript (/resume can't find it). Launch it with `env -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION …` (the full list is CALLER_SESSION_ENV in packages/engine/src/driver/adapter.ts), or use sofar drive, which scrubs them already.
